title: Preallocate ORDER schema keys
description: Avoid generic format! allocation work when ORDER BY primary-key LIMIT pushdown builds schema:<table> lookup keys from known table-name length.
implementation: Added order_schema_key_for_table() with explicit capacity for schema:<table>.
Replaced primary_key_order_scan_limit() schema lookup key construction.
Added unit coverage for helper output and capacity.
result: ORDER schema-key construction now reserves capacity from known table-name length while preserving ORDER BY primary-key LIMIT pushdown, range pushdown, index-cache behavior, and general SELECT ORDER BY behavior.
